description: This file defines the 'XValues' class, which represents a collection of values on the X-Axis in a chart within the MigraDoc Document Object Model. It provides methods for adding series, serialization, cloning, and index access, and manages internal values related to X-Axis data.

classes.name: XValues
classes.description: Represents the collection of X-Axis values in a chart.

classes.name: XValuesValues
classes.description: Houses internal nullable property values for the 'XValues' class.

methods.name: XValues(DocumentObject parent)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the collection with a parent object.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the 'XValues' object.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Indexer to access an 'XSeries' by index.

methods.name: AddXSeries
methods.description: Adds a new 'XSeries' to the collection.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the collection to a given serializer.
